powers.name: Elemental Burst
powers.effect: The character makes a ranged attack against an enemy in line of sight within 10 spaces. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage instead and the elemental type's special effect.

powers.name: Elemental Blast
powers.effect: The character makes a ranged attack with an edge at an enemy in line of sight within 10 spaces. For this attack, add +1 to the character's Agility damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes double that total damage and suffers the elemental type's special effect.

powers.name: Elemental Barrage
powers.effect: The character designates a space within their line of sight. The attack can affect every enemy within 10 spaces of that. The character makes a single Ego check and compares it to each target's Resilience defense. Affected enemies take half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, they take full regular damage and the elemental type's special effect.

powers.name: Telepathic Blast
powers.effect: The character makes a Logic attack against a target in line of sight. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular Focus damage. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage instead and is stunned for one round.

powers.name: Inspiration
powers.effect: The character inspires an ally in earshot. The ally gains an edge on all action checks until the start of the character's next turn.

powers.name: Battle Plan
powers.effect: The character inspires one or more allies of their choice in earshot, up to the character's Vigilance. Inspired allies gain an edge on all action checks until the start of the character's next turn.

powers.name: Telepathic Link
powers.effect: The character can communicate telepathically with one person at a time, and they must have met or seen the other person before. There is no limit to the distance of the communication, as long as the character and the target are in the same dimension. If the other person does not wish to speak with the character, the target can automatically tune them out. To force a telepathic link, the character can make a Logic check against the target's Vigilance defense. On a failure, the character cannot attempt to communicate with the target this way for the rest of the day. On a success, the character can communicate with the target for one round. On a Fantastic success, the target cannot shut the character out for the rest of the day.

powers.name: Mind Reading
powers.effect: The character can read the thoughts of a single person with whom they have established a Telepathic Link. This requires a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the character can read the target's surface thoughts. On a Fantastic success, the character can ask a single simple question and get the answer from the target's mind.

powers.name: Command
powers.effect: The character gives an order to a target with whom they have established a Telepathic Link. The character makes a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the target complies with the order. On a Fantastic success, the character gains an edge the next time they use this power against this same target. The command must be completable in a single action. If it involves harming someone, the character has trouble on the check. If it would cause the target to harm themselves, the character has double trouble.

powers.name: Elemental Protection 2
powers.effect: The character protects themselves with their element. Any attacks against them that do 20 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 20 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.

powers.name: Elemental Reinforcement
powers.effect: The character can transfer any Health damage that gets through an elemental power that grants damage protection to their Focus instead, leaving the protection intact.
powers.trigger: Damage gets through an elemental power.

powers.name: Flight 1
powers.effect: The character can fly. Their combat Flight Speed is equal to their rank times their Run Speed. Outside of combat, they can move three times their Flight Speed.

powers.name: Sturdy 2
powers.effect: +2 Health Damage Reduction. Reduces all incoming Health damage by 2 before it is applied. Always active.

powers.name: Discipline 2
powers.effect: The character adds +2 to their Ego damage multiplier, and they gain a +2 bonus to Ego checks other than attacks.

traits.name: Battle Ready
traits.effect: The character is always mentally prepared for trouble. Add +30 Focus permanently.

traits.name: Signature Attack: Elemental Burst
traits.effect: Edge when making attacks with one particular weapon or attack power. Can be taken more than once, each for a different weapon or power.

traits.name: Presence
traits.effect: Edge on Ego checks that involve getting people to pay attention or voluntarily do things for the character.

traits.name: Connections: Police
traits.effect: Knows someone with access to a particular field (reporter, officer, politician, etc.). Make an Ego check to call on them for clues, information or resources. Narrator sets TN. Can be taken multiple times for different types.

traits.name: Interrogation
traits.effect: Edge on Ego or Logic checks made when asking questions.

traits.name: Investigation
traits.effect: Edge on Vigilance checks to spot clues and Logic checks to interpret them. With access to a forensics lab, gains a second edge on such checks.

tags.name: Hounded
tags.effect: The character is a member of a group persecuted simply for being themselves.

tags.name: X-Gene
tags.effect: The character has the mutant gene that causes them to develop super-powers. Restriction: Mutants only.

tags.name: Heroic
tags.effect: The character acts heroically — they help people in need and do their best not to kill, even those who might deserve it. Restriction: Cannot also be Villainous.

tags.name: Secret Identity
tags.effect: The character's real identity is a secret. This may keep loved ones safe from enemies, but can also cause strain in those relationships.

tags.name: Mentor
tags.effect: The character knows an older person they can ask for advice — even about having super-powers. Can be taken multiple times.
